serply.description: Serply MCP Server - Google web, news, scholar, maps, jobs and video search, Bing search, Amazon product search and URL scraping through the Serply.io API. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no local install required; set SERPLY_API_KEY to a key from https://serply.io (paid, prepaid credits from $5; new accounts get 2,500 free credits) and see https://serply.io/docs for the API reference.
